sloka: अयं गिरिश्चित्रकूट इयं मन्दाकिनी नदी ।एतत् प्रकाशते दूरान्नीलमेघनिभं वनम् ॥ २.९३.८॥
transliteration: ayaṁ giriścitrakūṭa iyaṁ mandākinī nadī ।etat prakāśate dūrānnīlameghanibhaṁ vanam ॥ 2.93.8॥

translations.english: This mountain is Chitrakuta and this river, Mandakini. The forest shines from a distance like a blue cloud.
